Once I have that, I can tell you which ones to cancel and which ones I want to return. My name is Amelia, and I use the emails silva7872@example.com and amelia.silva7872@example.com. I live in Philadelphia. Could you start by pulling up my recent orders, please?

Also, just to plan ahead, could you let me know what options I have for the refund—whether it will go back to the original credit card, to a store credit, or if there’s a direct bank transfer available? I’m trying to keep everything as simple as possible given my current situation.
